description: Date Picker Plume is a calendar date slicer. Drop a date column in Date and, optionally, a measure in Value: the visual shows one to twelve months, greys out the days without data and filters the whole report with a range, a single date, a week or a month. It answers the most frequent date-slicer requests: open on the latest date, weeks starting on Monday, ISO week numbers, days without data that cannot be picked. FREE, NO WATERMARK - 1 to 12 months side by side or fitted to the frame, quick month and year picker, week starting Monday, Sunday or Saturday, ISO or US week numbers - Range in two clicks with hover preview, Shift + click to extend; single date, whole week (click a week number) or whole month - "Latest date" shortcut (last selectable day with data) and 12 more: today, yesterday, last 7 / 30 days, week, month, quarter, year to date, last 12 months… - Default selection on open, or every time the page is shown: the published report always reopens on the latest date - Days without data (blank measure or missing date) greyed out and not selectable - Selectable days: weekdays (e.g. Fridays only), month start or end, first or last working day, last day with data of the month, week, quarter and year ends; exclude holidays or future dates; a range can filter only these days - Public holidays (France, UK, US, Belgium, Switzerland, Germany) plus your own dates and closures -…
